title: *Where to get full text and point-of-care references: library access through your employer, college or association first, then university library guides, then the subscription references and their free routes.*

heading: Library Access
title: BCCNM - BC libraries for nurses (PD planning resources)
note: which health authority, ministry and college libraries BC nurses can use, with contacts and community borrower routes; NNPBC members whose employer gives no library access can register with NNPBC for eHLbc

heading: Library Access
title: eHLbc - Electronic Health Library of BC
note: licenses CINAHL, MEDLINE and other health databases for its 45 members in BC and Yukon, including the health authorities, FNHA, universities, colleges and NNPBC; you sign in through your member organization

heading: Point-of-Care References
title: NNPBC - UpToDate Subscription Reimbursement Policy
note: UpToDate reimbursed once a year for primary care NPs in publicly funded settings: PCN contractors, CHC employees and the First Nations Primary Care Initiative; not health authority or private for-profit NPs

heading: Point-of-Care References
title: UpToDate
note: International source: US (Wolters Kluwer). Clinical reference topics; *subscription*, or free through an employer or library that licenses it

heading: Point-of-Care References
title: DynaMed
note: International source: US (EBSCO). Clinical reference topics with drug monographs; *subscription*; eHLbc (BC) licenses it for some members, including UBC and UNBC

heading: Point-of-Care References
title: BMJ Best Practice
note: International source: UK (BMJ). Diagnosis and management topics; *subscription* or *institutional login*, with a free institutional trial
